# std/xxhash

XXH64, the fast non-cryptographic hash zstd uses for its frame checksum, in pure Milo.
The output matches `xxhsum -H64` bit for bit.

```milo
from "std/xxhash" import { Xxhash }
```

## Example

```milo
print(Xxhash.hex64("hello", 0))   // 26c7827d889f6da3
```
